pieces.title: A palace is not a tree
pieces.caption: Three hubs and eighteen pages, drawn twice. On the left each page is filed under one parent. On the right every real tie is kept, and the red pages belong to more than one. *What is real and what is a choice:* The right-hand ties are all real links. The left is the same pages with every tie but one thrown away. *Leaking in:* Kuramoto Coupling, Spinoza Conatus, STIGMERGY and their shared neighbours.

verdicts.file: Christopher Alexander — rich — a palace is not a tree.png
verdicts.why: Words only; the picture can stay. The caption's "every real tie is kept" is not so: only page-to-hub ties are drawn (the hub-to-hub link Spinoza Conatus → Kuramoto Coupling and all ties among the eighteen are left out; the in-image footer says it correctly). And the honesty line does not own the pick: the eighteen are ten of the 24 overlapping pages plus eight single-hub ones, chosen from 123 neighbours, so 56 percent of what is shown overlaps where 20 percent really does.
